senses.gloss: m. (כּוּן, cmp. כַּוָּנָה) exact selection of place.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15:1">Gen. R. s. 15</cite>, beg. <he>צריכה כ׳</he> (planting) requires exact selection; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15:1">ib.</cite> <he>צריך לכַוֵּון את רוחותיה</he> one must determine its position with reference to the cardinal points.
